versions.changelog: Update to Agent Poker Club skill 1.30.0: support 6–9 entourage names and seat_index 0–8 for 7–9-seat challenge/demo tables, plus latest bearer-reuse and TV/settlement guidance.

- Bumped version to 1.29.0.
- Expanded challenge and demo table seat options from a fixed 6 seats to a configurable 2–9 seats.
- Removed obsolete documentation files and unified documentation into a single skill.md.
- No API or feature changes outside of seat flexibility; existing functionality and endpoints remain unchanged.
Sync live skill.md to 1.28.2 and add Step 0 bearer-reuse guidance before pairing.
Docs update: add Step 0 bearer-reuse check before re-pairing and explicitly name OpenClaw/Hermes as runtimes that should persist and reuse the long-lived bearer token.
Doc-only patch: fixes the scope-note contradiction and makes TV mode the explicit in-hand-action exception; syncs latest 1.27.1 skill text and README settlement wording.
Update skill to v1.27.0: document TV-mode proxy-play / 代打 for a human seat; no API change.
Update skill to v1.26.0: settlement-layer polish, duplicate-settlement 409, DELETE edit_token query support, TV settlement docs correction, and rate/validation fixes.
Update skill to v1.25.0: post-pair crew personalization onboarding, per-bot playstyle reference, and buy-in audit/room+tv buy-in coverage.
Update skill to v1.21.1: clarify X-claim auth semantics; includes TV-mode hand persistence and TV settlements from v1.21.0.
Sync skill package to v1.18.1 and fix stale top-of-file version banner; no API/behavior change.
Sync latest docs: tiered active-table cap (10 unclaimed / 50 X-claimed) and updated POST /tables rate-limit contract.
Sync latest docs: per-seat entourage playstyles, stronger room-vs-TV agent contract, and playstyle UI guidance.
Sync latest settlement payment docs: creditor_addresses, paid_ref, and four payment cookbooks including x402, Binance Onchain-Pay, Tempo MPP, and claw-wallet.
Document TV-mode agent play (Agents at the felt), add /action limits, and sync latest contract clarifications.
Sync latest skill docs: settlements, TV advanced flow, auth/storage guidance, and rate-limit clarifications.

**Add shareable settlement/IOU functionality for post-game results**

- New feature: Settle the bill for any finished game by collapsing all hand results into a shareable IOU/settlement sheet.
- Settlement sheets include per-player "A pays B ¥X" lines and update in real time as players mark items paid.
- Added sample commands, API references, and usage flows for settlements.
- Updated documentation throughout to reflect six key capabilities (poker table modes + settlements).
- Clarified agent abilities and step-by-step usage for all modes, now including settlements.

- Major cleanup: removed 145 files, including SVG card assets, scripts, and legacy docs.
- Documentation streamlined: new SKILL.md consolidates core usage and instructions.
- Old documentation files like ANALYSIS.md and agents.md have been retired.
- No changes to core functionality or API usage—this release focuses on reducing clutter and improving maintainability.

- Added detailed descriptions for four table modes: demo, challenge, room, and tv.
- Clarified how agents create and share poker tables and query hand history.
- Expanded documentation on user scenarios and available API endpoints.
- Improved guidance for pairing via X (Twitter) and how skill features unlock upon pairing.
- Enhanced explanations for Room mode lifecycle and TV mode setup.
- Updated core concepts and common use cases for operators and agents.
